title: Positioning AI Tools to Support Online Harm Reduction Practice: Applications and Design Directions

bias_targets.target: Bias against People Who Use Drugs (PWUD)
bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of LLM responses to substance use queries through stakeholder workshops to assess whether the model adopts moralizing, prohibitionist, or judgmental tones versus non-judgmental, harm-reduction-aligned framing.

Comparing the quality, safety protocols, and contextual accuracy of LLM-generated harm reduction responses across different languages (specifically English and Chinese) to evaluate linguistic disparities.

Testing the LLM's contextual sensitivity by modifying queries with regional markers (e.g., Scotland, UK, China) to assess its ability to provide appropriate local support services, resources, and legal implications.

primary_bias_target: Bias against People Who Use Drugs (PWUD)
